conclusion: No block lemma below base 2 and no unconditional obstruction, but the arm is now exactly located: pruning a block T is the independent-set problem for the union of antipodal graphs mod p in T, the joint probabilistic bound lands on exactly 2^-r, and that constant is unimprovable by any argument reading only residues mod prod(T). The brief's own target is one notch too low: g(k) <= 2/rho_min(k) <= 2g(k) makes block-pruning equivalent to Erdos #126, so retention 2^{-r+o(r)} merely reproduces Erdos-Turan and only c^{-r} with c<2 is progress.
confidence: The four statements labelled lemma/theorem in RESULTS.md are proved and independently machine-checked where checkable (Theorem 3's exact formula matches exhaustive branch-and-bound 4 times out of 4; Lemma 1 has 0 mismatches in 200 random instances). Lean on those. Do not lean on section 7's measured positive correlation across primes: n <= 11, and its most striking column is the conjecture restated rather than evidence for it. One drafted claim (phi = number of sign-orbits met) was false and is recorded as such with its counterexample.
